name: ANSI/IEEE Bidirectional breakdown diode form
summary: IEEE-library form of bidirectional breakdown diode: a bidirectional breakdown diode provides a documented voltage-limiting semiconductor path in both polarities.
description: This reference locates bidirectional breakdown diode in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented semiconductor components family. A bidirectional breakdown diode provides a documented voltage-limiting semiconductor path in both polarities. Its working voltage and surge characteristics determine the protective application. The public library uses HDI1_S00647 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Follow the actual current path and terminal polarity in the surrounding circuit. The symbol identifies an electrical function; voltage, current, energy limits and the device package pinout come from the selected component data rather than from the outline.

Read working-voltage and breakdown specifications separately. Bidirectional protection does not make the component a controllable power switch. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
